front: Main job of LLD in a team?
back: Reduce the cost of building and changing software.

front: How does LLD enable parallel work?
back: Agreed interfaces let people build each side independently against the same contract.
Interfaces plus injected dependencies let tests use fakes instead of real services.

front: Risk of big design up front?
back: Long documents that go stale before code is written.
Proportional to how central and long-lived the code is.
